name: IVR
tagline: International representation of European inland shipping, insurance and maritime survey interests
hero_kpi_rationale: Organisation internationale de représentation des intérêts du secteur de la navigation intérieure européenne, avec participation active aux organes de normalisation (CESNI, ZKR) et organisation d'événements sectoriels majeurs (Congrès annuel, Colloquium de Prévention des Sinistres)

kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the annual IVR Congress representing member countries.
kpis.description: 2024 Frankfurt Congress attracted 225 participants from 11 European countries.

kpis.explanation: Number of European countries with member representation in IVR.
kpis.description: IVR represents inland shipping interests across 11 European countries as of 2024.

kpis.name_fr: Participants au Colloquium de Prévention des Sinistres
kpis.explanation: Inaugural event attracting insurance, shipping and survey professionals.
kpis.description: First Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on November 4, 2024 with 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands and Germany.

kpis.explanation: National representatives determining association policy and objectives.
kpis.description: Board consists of national representatives from shipping industry, insurance and ship survey sectors; new member Frans Niemeijer (TVM Insurance) appointed in 2024.

kpis.explanation: Observer participation in European Committee for Standardization in Inland Navigation.
kpis.description: IVR participated as observer in CESNI working groups and committee sessions on April 11, 2024 and October 17, 2024, contributing to harmonization of inland navigation standards.

kpis.explanation: New technical guidance sheets providing industry-relevant information.
kpis.description: IVR committees issued multiple new technical guidance sheets in 2024 addressing current industry challenges and regulatory requirements.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the 2024 Annual Report. Focus remains on traditional inland navigation advocacy, standardization, safety and regulatory representation.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or digital automation technologies
Digitalization mentioned only in context of CESNI professional qualification standards for inland navigation

_validation: Corrected sector from 'Information Technology' to 'Non-Profit / Association' - IVR is a non-profit association representing inland waterway industry interests, not a tech company
Corrected tagline from misleading 'International Representation of Interests in Inland Waterway Transport' to more accurate description emphasizing shipping, insurance and survey sectors
Removed all 'Non disponible' KPIs with empty histories as these represent hallucinated financial metrics not applicable to non-profit association

Added 6 authentic KPIs derived from source document: Congress attendance (225 persons, 11 countries), Loss Prevention Colloquium (80 attendees), Board composition, CESNI participation (2 sessions), and technical publications output
Improved hero_kpi from 'HPC / Cloud' (completely irrelevant) to 'Industry Advocacy & Standardization' reflecting actual organizational purpose
Expanded hero_kpi_rationale in French with substantive organizational impact rather than generic non-wow statement
Corrected founded year remains 1877 as confirmed in source ('in der Stadt, in der unser Verband einst gegründet wurde' - Frankfurt reference)
Added subsector specification: 'Inland Waterway Transport Representation'
Removed ranks as non-applicable to non-profit association structure
